stem: The volume of water, in liters, in a rainwater tank on a rooftop \(t\) minutes after a rainstorm begins is given by \(W(t) = 25t + 140\). According to the function, how many liters of water are in the tank 12 minutes after the rainstorm begins?
verify:
t = symbols('t')
W = 25*t + 140
ans = W.subs(t, 12)
assert ans == 440
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans and len(spr_answers) == 1
